Main entry point that registers topology callbacks, stages, tiles, and actions, then calls fd_main.

# Purpose
This file defines the main entry point for the Firedancer application. It sets the application and binary names, then builds the lists of available topology object callbacks, configuration stages, runtime tiles, and command actions. These arrays act as registration tables for the program startup path, so `fd_main` can discover the supported components and initialize the system through `fd_topo_initialize`. The [`main`](<#main>) function also creates the built-in configuration presets for `default`, `testnet`, `devnet`, and `mainnet`, then passes them to `fd_main` together with the command-line arguments.

The file also contains [`add_bench_topo`](<#add_bench_topo>), which is a placeholder hook for bench topology generation. The function accepts many topology and network parameters, but it does not use them and only casts them to void. This shows that the file is part of the application bootstrap and command registration layer, not a file that implements tile logic or configuration stages itself.
